generated.description: A large stone-and-spruce university complex with a tall central tower, a long main hall with rows of arched windows, and a sunken courtyard with a small pond and grass. It is built from stone bricks, spruce planks and logs, with gold and diamond block accents, and it stands about 74 wide, 63 high and 37 deep. Inside are a bookshelf-lined interior area, chests, a beacon, a cauldron, banners, signs and a record player.
